title: Little Worlds: Line-Art Control Laboratory — 20 Controlled Variants
purpose: Controlled style experiment with five scene concepts and four shared-prompt style variants per scene. Each scene's four variants use the same seed to isolate prompt wording more cleanly. Intended to choose a production art direction, not to serve as the final book.
global_prompt: Original whimsical miniature-fantasy coloring illustration for ages 7–99. Clean black linework on pure white paper, with open white interiors designed for hand coloring. One obvious hero silhouette, only a few useful supporting objects, rounded friendly forms, clearly separated objects, and a calm eye-level composition. Surface detail is sparse, purposeful, and medium-large; visual richness comes from imaginative shapes and scale.

style_variants.V1: Render the scene as crisp black-ink outline coloring art. Use clear bold outer contours, a few delicate but readable interior contours, plain white object interiors, and white open sky areas. Keep the page graphic, clean, and easy to color.
style_variants.V2: Use an extra-cute rounded storybook illustration style with friendly oversized proportions, smooth confident black contours, broad surfaces, and a clear hero silhouette. Enclosed shapes remain white and colorable; the visual charm comes from rounded shapes and playful scale.
style_variants.V3: Prioritize a relaxed coloring experience: build the image around four to six large readable shapes, broad unmarked surfaces, a handful of meaningful supporting details, clean closed boundaries, and generous white space between objects. Use crisp black outline art on white paper.
style_variants.V4: Make the objects feel gently dimensional through overlapping silhouettes and a few purposeful contour lines. Use bold black outer outlines, sparse thinner inner outlines, smooth rounded geometry, clear white interiors, and a polished miniature-fantasy storybook look.

pages.label: Cloudtop Observatory · V1
pages.subject: A cozy observatory inside a giant soft cloud cottage. One large rounded telescope is the main foreground object beside a tall arched window. Through the window is an open white sky, one crescent moon drawn as a simple outline, and three large hollow star outlines. Add one small round table with a single closed book and one plain oval rug. Broad cloud curves form the room.
